text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Monday chaired a cabinet meeting on modernising public administration.
- Industry minister on Monday held a meeting in the southern island of Jerba with Libyan energy minister on electricity link and bilateral cooperation in energy sector.
- China donates sports and computer equipment to Tunisia.
- Tunis Book Fair started with record attendance by children.
- Tunisia, Iraq signed cultural cooperation agreements in Baghdad.
